On the left side, R1 is connected to the left carbonyl carbon; the carbonyl carbon forms a double bond with O and is connected to N; N is also connected to H and to the middle carbon; the middle carbon is connected to R2 and is connected to the right carbonyl carbon; the right carbonyl carbon is connected to R3 and forms a double bond with O. There are 8 bonds in total.

method.method_draft: Assign non-H degrees from the drawn structure: left carbonyl carbon connects to N, R1, and O (degree 3); N connects to the left carbonyl carbon and central carbon after excluding H (degree 2); central carbon connects to N, R2, and right carbonyl carbon (degree 3); right carbonyl carbon connects to central carbon, R3, and O (degree 3); each of R1, R2, R3, and the two O atoms has degree 1.
